scope: Independent native checks for an existing public issue and author patch
environment: Linux amd64, Go 1.25.10, non-root, original go.mod/go.sum, offline tests
failure_count_unit: Go test nodes, including parent tests; two full-suite failures represent one failed subtest and its parent
limits: No minimum-Go, Windows/macOS, benchmarks, upstream CI/acceptance or broad parser-correctness qualification
